## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-xmfg-f9cm-w86q. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description
NLTK from 3.9.4 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink following vulnerability in nltk.sem.chat80.sql_query() that bypasses the pathsec data-root sandbox containment check. Attackers who can write into a trusted NLTK data root can plant a symbolic link to read SQLite databases outside the sandbox.
Advisory.Summary: Duplicate Advisory: Symlink escape in chat80.sql_query bypasses the pathsec data-root sandbox to read out-of-root SQLite databases
